title: SlicerRemoteView protocol v1.0 — common definitions
description: Reusable definitions referenced by every message schema (docs/protocol.md §3.2, §3.3, §4, §5, §9). Kept to a draft-07-compatible subset of 2020-12 (`definitions`, no `$defs`/`unevaluatedProperties`/`$dynamicRef`) because NJsonSchema does not resolve `#/$defs/` yet — see shared/README.md, generator spike (PRO-02).
$comment: Protocol v1.0. Prose in docs/protocol.md is normative for behaviour; these schemas are normative for shapes (§14).

timestampMs.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, informational only (§3.2).

code.description: 5-character session code, alphabet 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ (no 0 O 1 I L; §4.2, ADR 0008).

sessionId.description: Relay-generated opaque session identifier (§4.2). Charset and length are schema-defined (§14) and bind the relay generator (SRV-02).

token.description: Publisher or viewer token: ≥ 128 random bits as base64url, i.e. at least 43 characters (§4.2, §5.2, NFR-17); the 256-character cap is schema-defined (§14). Never logged, never in URL paths.

snapshotVersion.description: sceneVersion of a GLB snapshot; never 0, because 0 means nothing published (§4.2, §6.2, §8.4).

matrix.description: 4×4 transform as 16 numbers, column-major as in glTF (§7, §8.1).

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters (§6.2, §6.4).

byteLength.description: Size of a complete GLB snapshot in bytes, at most MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES = 64 MiB (§3.3, §6.2).

snapshotFormat.description: Container format of a snapshot; v1 knows only binary glTF (§6.2).

viewerLimit.description: Effective MAX_VIEWERS, at most the protocol maximum of 20 (§3.3, §4.2, §5.2).

snapshotInfo.description: Cached snapshot a viewer can fetch over GET /api/scene/:sceneVersion (§5.2, §6.5).

profile.description: Decimation budget profile the publisher exported for (§4.1, §7.5).

platform.description: Viewer platform (§5.1). Publishers send a free-form platform string instead (§4.1); receivers treat unknown values as `other` (§14).
platform.$comment: Not referenced by a message schema on purpose: clientInfo.platform stays a lenient string (§14). Kept as the documented viewer set for generated constants (PRO-06) and the C# enum with an Other fallback (PRO-17).

clientInfo.description: Who is connecting (§4.1, §5.1). No device identifiers, no user names.

ttl.description: Session lifetime parameters announced by the relay (§4.2, §3.3).

limits.description: Effective relay limits, at most the protocol maximums of §3.3 (§4.2, §14).

sessionExpiringReason.description: `reason` of `session.expiring` (§4.4: the idle timer is the only trigger in v1.0).
